frontend_controls: Restoration is lazy on Change and reads only the opaque token present in current private draft payload.
FreshQualifier keys the editor by group token plus draft proof; changing either remounts before stale private text can be rendered.

Hook aborts on owner teardown and uses AbortController object identity plus aborted state to reject late responses, including leave/return-to-same-owner and ignored abort. No extra generation/nonce state.
Response failure uses a fixed non-sensitive message, retains the valid private proof and does not POST or mutate draft collection.
Inactive/expired/consumed selections do not hydrate saved text or autosave. User can explicitly choose again; no proof clearing on read failure.
Only explicit successful save writes the newly issued opaque proof into existing private draft collection; post-await signal check prevents late save from replacing proof after cancellation.
No relationship text or new proof persistence in localStorage/sessionStorage, URL query, telemetry, console or logs. Existing public transport/session helper remains unchanged.
